title: Customer Loyalty and Rewards, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Customer Loyalty and Rewards agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

names.manual: Customer Loyalty and Rewards Workspace Manual

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the 4 lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members list.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Synthetic Platinum Member (LoyaltyMemberId LM-10001), with Tier platinum.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Cust Loyalty Rewards Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, 4 skills, 1 rules knowledge file(s) and 4 SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Loyalty Program Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Loyalty Program Director, summarize the synthetic program health and governance boundary.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Loyalty Program Director; Synthetic Loyalty Program Dashboard; no member is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: CRM Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As CRM Manager, explain the synthetic Gold member balance without changing the ledger.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** CRM Manager; Synthetic Points Summary; Synthetic Gold Member. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Marketing Leader
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Marketing Leader, show review-only reward options without creating offers or issuing benefits.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Leader; Draft Reward Option Recommendations; no points, tier, offer, reward. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Test: Loyalty Program Director
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Loyalty Program Director, review the synthetic tier structure without changing member status.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Tier Analysis; Tier Structure; no member is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Customer Loyalty and Rewards: 4 read-only tabs from the same lists. 4 fictional records, including Synthetic Platinum Member (LoyaltyMemberId LM-10001), with Tier platinum.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

steps.title: Create Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload loyalty-members.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set LoyaltyMemberId, Tier, MemberSince, PreferredRewards to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep PointsBalance, PointsEarnedYtd, PointsRedeemedYtd, TotalSpendYtd, EngagementScore as Number. Name the list Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including Synthetic Platinum Member (LoyaltyMemberId LM-10001), with Tier platinum.

steps.title: Create Customer Loyalty and Rewards Tier Structure from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload tier-structure.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set TierStructureId, Perks, NextTier to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep MinSpend, PointsMultiplier, SpendToNext as Number. Name the list Customer Loyalty and Rewards Tier Structure. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 4 fictional records, including bronze (TierStructureId bronze), with MinSpend 0.

steps.title: Create Customer Loyalty and Rewards Redemption Catalog from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload redemption-catalog.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set RedemptionCatalogId, Category to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Keep PointsCost, Value as Number. Name the list Customer Loyalty and Rewards Redemption Catalog. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including $500 Travel Voucher (RedemptionCatalogId travel_voucher_500), with PointsCost 25000.

steps.title: Create Customer Loyalty and Rewards Engagement Activities from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload engagement-activities.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column. Set EngagementActivityId, Activity, Points, Frequency to Single line of text. Keep dates as ISO text, not Date and time; years and numeric-looking identifiers stay text (2022, not 2,022). Name the list Customer Loyalty and Rewards Engagement Activities. Preserve the CSV column order.
steps.expected: 6 fictional records, including 1 (EngagementActivityId 1), with Activity Purchase.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Cust Loyalty R Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there.
steps.expected: The studio instructions name the 4 list tools and map every Title and field_N column.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

steps.title: Add the rules-and-controls knowledge
steps.action: Knowledge, Add, upload aibast_loyalty-rewards-rules-and-safety.md, and wait until ready. Do not upload the synthetic-records file: those records come from the list tools.
steps.expected: 1 rules knowledge file(s) listed as ready.

steps.title: Add the loyalty members tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members; name the tool Get loyalty member records.
steps.expected: Get loyalty member records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the tier structure tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Customer Loyalty and Rewards Tier Structure; name the tool Get tier structure records.
steps.expected: Get tier structure records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the redemption catalog tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Customer Loyalty and Rewards Redemption Catalog; name the tool Get redemption catalog records.
steps.expected: Get redemption catalog records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the engagement activities tool
steps.action: Tools, Add a tool, SharePoint, Get items. Set Site Address to your site and List Name to Customer Loyalty and Rewards Engagement Activities; name the tool Get engagement activity records.
steps.expected: Get engagement activity records is listed under Tools.

steps.title: Add the 4 skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each studio SKILL.md from the downloads.
steps.expected: 4 skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.title: Review the agent
steps.action: Check the model, 4 skills, the rules knowledge and 4 tools.
steps.expected: Sonnet 4.6, 4 skills, 1 knowledge file(s), 4 Get items tools, no web search, nothing else.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Loyalty Program Director, summarize the synthetic program health and governance boundary.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Loyalty Program Director; Synthetic Loyalty Program Dashboard; no member is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.

steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** CRM Manager; Synthetic Points Summary; Synthetic Gold Member. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.prompt: As Marketing Leader, show review-only reward options without creating offers or issuing benefits.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Prepared for:** Marketing Leader; Draft Reward Option Recommendations; no points, tier, offer, reward. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: As Loyalty Program Director, review the synthetic tier structure without changing member status.
steps.expected: The relevant list tool ran. Required evidence: Synthetic Tier Analysis; Tier Structure; no member is contacted. Preserve the synthetic-data and authorized-review boundaries; no external action occurred.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Generate the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: customer-loyalty-rewards-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the 4 lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Tier Structure" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Redemption Catalog" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Engagement Activities" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the 4 tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Customer Loyalty and Rewards Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and open the Customer Loyalty and Rewards Loyalty Members tab.
steps.expected: The app and the agent read the same synthetic records. 4 fictional records, including Synthetic Platinum Member (LoyaltyMemberId LM-10001), with Tier platinum.
